'''Sector 340-NJ''', known informally as '''Blood Town''', was a district of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It was located in the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|Undercity]], below the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The [[Arealleath Corporation]] maintained a large [[Factory/Legends|factory]] above the sector, which produced a [[Color|red]] haze that spread throughout the district, giving it its name.<ref name="LoNH" />
